policy: Project-consistent Simplified Chinese names; not claimed as an official Chinese canon. Source spellings and actual literal codes are preserved in source data.

entries.notes: Full name / given name / surname retain the same components.
Use the short Chinese name in ordinary dialogue; retain the full Chinese name in formal introductions and signatures.
Planet/system/sector and the game title use the same base name; X is a variant designation.
Concise project Chinese alias; retains the same English source identity. Not an official Chinese name.
Deli is the familiar abbreviation in ep4.cube37; translated as the full place name.
Concise project Chinese alias; retains the same English source identity. Not an official Chinese name.
Use the short Chinese name in ordinary dialogue; retain the full Chinese name in formal introductions and signatures.
General/Lord are contextual titles. Order, Cult, church and followers remain distinct contextual nouns.
The injured person in ep4.cube27, project in ep4.cube49 and fleet modifier in ep5.cube04 share the source name without conflating their roles.
USP is retained only as its literal product-series abbreviation; the spelled-out class description is Chinese.
USP and equipment model serials remain literal identifiers.
HX-21 remains a literal model serial.
Main is translated as 主; the remaining facility description stays 聚变电站.
Transliterated base name, without inventing an acronym expansion.
The signature/series name is not assumed to be identical to the separately named Eclipse Central broadcaster.
Baker is a character epithet, not a second personal name.
004-55506B/W and related serials remain unchanged.
Nort is the shortened sender label in ep1.cube15.
Unexplained term is transliterated; no invented expansion.
Conventional Chinese name for the astronomical body.
Source gives only WAR; rendered phonetically without inventing an acronym expansion.
III in Nova III remains the model designation; Nova system in ep4 uses the same base translation.
The fictional spelling Protron is not silently corrected to proton.
Unexplained creature label, phonetically rendered.
Chinese renderings 星际稀粥之家 and annotated English variants are standardized to this form.
ep1.cube28 literally says International, not Interstellar. Preserve that adjective and document the likely chain-name variant rather than silently correcting the source.
Planet and Gyges Phildren use the same base name; demonym is 盖吉斯风味/盖吉斯的 in context.
Plural and singular share one Chinese base; also appears as food in ep1.cube29.
Also served as food in ep1.cube29.
Also the huge crustacean platter in ep1.cube29.
Grand Moolah is the source’s satirical religious title.
Hyphenated ep1/ep4 and unhyphenated ep5 forms share one Chinese name.
ICBG acronym is translated to its already-present Chinese expanded brand name, with duplicate gloss removed.
Nonsense product name rendered consistently; Bars is translated as 棒.
C is a literal sector suffix and is retained.
Kept distinct from Gravitron 引力子.
Only a sender label in ep3.cube09.
Do not conflate with the Ninja sender label based only on a shared face.
Kept distinct from Gravitium 引力素.
Preserve the source Harbringer spelling by transliteration; do not silently replace it with Harbinger.
Illuminati occurs once in the same ep3.cube18 ship description and is treated as a source-name variant for this vessel, not a separate faction.
II remains a literal ship generation/designation.
The same name is used for the network and numbered TV channels; 21 is retained.
Distinct from the fictional dog Almo.
Distinct from Almos.
X3 remains a literal model identifier.
Travel-guide sender label, treated as a name/pen name.
Source spelling Ressurectos is retained in the English glossary.
Separate from Baker Bob.
ICOM is an abbreviation for the same device/system, translated rather than left as an unexpanded name.
L is a literal line identifier; do not invent an expansion.
Role label, without evidence of a personal name.
Fictional currency rendered phonetically.
